== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for High Anxiety: the entry “High Anxiety” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary Supplement'' (updated 29 January 2002), PDF page 4. Image for [[High Anxiety (Decipher Errata 2002)]].
